reviews.body:
Thank you for contribution! 

Please address the comments and 
add test to verify that user client string always in the format: 

```
<app_name>/<app_version> <client_name>/<client_version> (<comment>; <key1>: <value1>; <key2>: <value2>)
```

Not parentheses in the middle (this is our format across all clients to make things clear) 

Thanks!

review_comments.body:
this will produce repeating parentheses like: 
```
my-analytics-app jdbc-v2/0.12.0-rc1-SNAPSHOT ((apache.spark))
clickhouse-java-v2/0.12.0-rc1-SNAPSHOT (env:staging; region:us-east-1; ...)
``` 
This is not a format we want to keep across all clients. Here is one correct: 
```
<app_name>/<app_version> <client_name>/<client_version> (<comment>; <key1>: <value1>; <key2>: <value2>)
```

please move to ConnectionImpl tests. We do no create standalone unit tests like this. 
generally we do prefer integration tests because unit tests verify only half of the logic.

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Pushed 08f64da and e778908 on top of the earlier commits:
- Detected frameworks no longer go into the client name. They are added to the client metadata as an `fw` entry, so the header keeps the format `<app>/<ver> jdbc-v2/<ver> clickhouse-java-v2/<ver> (fw:apache.spark; lv:...; os:...; hc:...)` with one parenthesis group. A `fw` entry set by the user in `client_id_metadata` wins. The metadata survives `updateClientName`, so `setClientInfo("ApplicationName", ...)` keeps the frameworks.
- Removed the standalone `ClientNameTest`. The test is now `ConnectionTest#testDetectedFrameworksInUserAgent` (integration group, next to `testClientMetadataInUserAgent`): it reads `http_user_agent` from `system.query_log` and checks the full format with a regex (single parenthesis group, with and without app name, detected frameworks, a user `fw` entry winning, detection disabled). No reflection on private fields.
- Updated docs and the history entry.

Your template shows a free `<comment>` item before the key/value pairs. This patch uses a keyed `fw` entry so it can be overridden through `client_id_metadata`. If you prefer the frameworks as the plain comment item, that is a small change.

Disclosure: this change was prepared with an AI coding assistant and reviewed before posting.
